# Nenisys

> Nenisys is a technology company based in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria, building products in trading and education. Owned and led by Christian Godliness Chimenem (CEO & Owner).

## Products
- Mercora Edge: a proprietary trading firm that evaluates traders and provides funded accounts, built on an in-house trading engine. Owned and operated by Nenisys. Launching 30 October 2026. Previously developed under the working name Genex.
- Edutech AI: a learning app in development. Students write or draw on a phone screen or whiteboard, and an AI replies with feedback based on the text and the drawing.

## People
- Christian Godliness Chimenem: CEO & Owner. Software engineer; undergraduate Physics student.
